subject.facility_name: TORRINGTON CENTER FOR NURSING & REHABILITATION LLC

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $152.45 per resident day (38.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 6.6% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $260,274, 6.6% of the $3,942,881 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $735,460, $28.44 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $388,741 (52.9%), allocated fringe $131,264 (17.8%), non-wage costs $215,455 (29.3%). Raw food was $188,217 ($7.28 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $6,842.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $266,291, $10.3 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $173,025 (65.0%), allocated fringe $58,425 (21.9%), non-wage costs $34,841 (13.1%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $161,856, $6.26 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $115,129 (71.1%), allocated fringe $38,875 (24.0%), non-wage costs $7,852 (4.9%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2017, 2018, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2017 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2018 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
